# signet-nip46-client

> Rust NIP-46 remote-signer client with bunker and Nostr Connect pairing, persisted sessions and checked signing requests.

## Documentation

- [Rust integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-nip46-client/blob/main/README.md): Pairing flows, requirements for the calling application and the session contract.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-nip46-client): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [fray-relay-client](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray-relay-client): Underlying Nostr relay client in Rust.
